why: the wire-bytes tier of `cpp:bind_service`: the bound member is `bool C::on_request(const uint8_t* req, size_t req_len, uint8_t* resp, size_t resp_cap, size_t* resp_len)`, with no serialisation on either side and a `false` return dropping the reply.
